deviations.what: c6 S14.1 *Distribution · 1 Period*: heading 'Which stretch of the year?' with help 'The profit is the whole year's. These dates only set the stretch that interest is worked out over.', then a ruled card 'Financial year 2026-27' with From '01 Apr 2026' / To '07 Sep 2026' and a calendar-edit icon, values sitting mid-row; the frame has no heading, a plain card with From '1 Apr 2026 ▾' / To '31 Aug 2026 ▾' right-aligned, then 'PROFIT IN THIS PERIOD ₹5,94,000' and 'Money earned ₹14,82,000 − money spent ₹8,88,000'
deviations.reason: [screen] the period's profit is not shown on step 1; dates zero-padded ('01 Apr') where the frame writes '1 Apr'; the app defaults To to today, the frame to month end. The frame implies the dates set the profit; the app says they only bound interest (the profit is the year's) — the app's reading is the port's contract
deviations.authority: 02 §7.1 🔒; partners_port.dart DistributionPort.distributionPreview (the profit figure is the year's either way); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: c6 S14.1 *2 Preview*: a 'Profit for 2026-27 ₹5,94,000.00' card ('Interest on capital is off for this business, so there is one line each.'), then one card per owner titled with the account name ('Amrit Kaur — Partner Current A/c', '1 of 3') with 'Share ₹1,98,000.00' and a wrapped '… altogether ₹1,98,000.00' row; the frame lists the owners in one card ('Amrit Kaur', 'Share 1/3', 'Interest on capital ₹10,800 + share ₹1,90,200' with the total at the right), then 'Distributed ₹5,94,000' and 'The odd 40 paise went to Amrit Kaur, first in the list.'
deviations.reason: [screen] preview layout (card per owner vs one list), account-name titles, the 'altogether' row wraps to two lines; amounts carry paise ('₹1,98,000.00') where the frame drops them. The profit is the frame's ₹5,94,000 because the capture book is the worked example's season; the frame's interest lines are a book with interest on capital switched on, which this one is not (02 §7.1, off by default). How odd paise are split is the engine's; only the display is at issue
deviations.authority: 02 §7.1 🔒 (distribution per ownership ratio, integer paise); CLAUDE.md rule 1; ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: c6 S14.1 *3 Confirm*: heading 'Ready to record' / 'Every owner has to approve this. It waits in their Inbox until they do, and nothing changes before then.', a ruled card listing each owner's figure and 'The whole entry ₹5,94,000.00', and the commit button 'Propose to the owners' wrapping onto two lines, left-aligned inside the right half of the Back/Next footer; the frame says 'This posts one entry and moves no cash.' with a tinted summary (Period 1 Apr – 31 Aug 2026 · Profit shared ₹5,94,000 · Between 3 partners) and a full-width 'Share the profit'
deviations.reason: [screen] the commit label wraps and misaligns (footer splits the width with Back) — a layout defect. The frame's 'posts one entry' copy is wrong for this book: a shared business's distribution is structural and needs every owner's approval, so the app proposes rather than posts
